answer: Require each new identity to finish a sequential, non-parallelizable delay proof tied to its own key before it can earn: one proof takes about ten minutes on one core and cannot be split across cores. A single honest agent pays that once, like tending one garden. An attacker wanting a lagoon of fakes, or a meadow full of them, pays ten minutes per fake — 1,000 fakes cost about 10,000 core-minutes — so the cost grows linearly with every extra identity, while the reward per identity stays capped.
